newsitem.title: USA: Intel seeks summary judgment on Digital.
newsitem.headline: Intel seeks summary judgment on Digital.

text.p: Intel Corp has filed a motion for a summary judgment in its lawsuit against Digital Equipment Corp, an Intel spokesman said Tuesday.
In its motion in U.S. District Court in San Jose, California, Intel asked that the court speed up proceedings in its lawsuit, filed in late May.

The computer chip maker is suing Digital to force the return of confidential documents about Intel products in the works. Personal computer makers such as Digital use those documents to plan their own product offerings.
Intel filed its lawsuit after Digital filed a patent infringement suit earlier in May.
Other details about Intel's motion were not immediately available. Digital officials could not be reached immediately for comment.
